subject: Renewal + GovCloud deployment addendum / procurement portal steps

From: Susan Park <susan.park@embertech.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: GovCloud addendum + procurement onboarding

Hi Irene / Laura —

Quick note from procurement at EmberTech. We're moving a subset of our workloads to a GovCloud environment for next fiscal year and need to:

- Execute a renewal amendment that includes a GovCloud deployment addendum and updated terms for data residency and controls.
- Refresh vendor onboarding in our procurement portal so our SSO and PO flows work against the GovCloud tenant.
- Confirm any pricing uplift and lead times for capacity changes (we anticipate a 2x token / capacity increase for the subset).

Our timeline is tight: procurement wants an executed amendment and PO by May 1 to coordinate the GovCloud cutover in June. Can you confirm the right Redwood contacts, the docs you'll need from us, and whether the portal onboarding can be completed within two weeks?

Attachments: EmberTech_PO_Template.pdf (PO template)

Thanks,
Susan Park
Senior Procurement Manager
EmberTech
procurement@embertech.com

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Susan Park <susan.park@embertech.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2029-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: GovCloud addendum + procurement onboarding

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear note and the PO template. We're happy to support the GovCloud addendum and the procurement portal refresh.

Next steps from our side (quick mutual action plan):
1) I'll open an amendment draft (GovCloud-Deployment-Addendum-draft.docx) and share redlines with your legal team — target by EOD 4/12.
2) Please upload your SOC 2 supplement and the PO template to the procurement portal (or send privately) so we can pre-fill the onboarding profile. For speed, you can reply to this thread with SOC2-supplement.pdf.
3) Laura (cc'd) will propose the pricing/commit schedule for GovCloud capacity and confirm the payment terms (Net-30 vs Net-45). Expect a pricing note by 4/13.
4) Marissa (cc'd, CS/ops) will coordinate the portal invite and technical checklist for GovCloud tenancy mapping — we'll need the vendor technical contact and the service account email you plan to use.

We understand the May 1 date. If we get your SOC2 file and the PO template by tomorrow afternoon, we can aim to have the amendment routed for signature by 4/20 so you have time for procurement and internal approvals.

Attachments: procure_onboarding_checklist.pdf (checklist we use for portal re-onboarding)

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Irene / Susan — Tom here from EmberTech IT procurement (cc'd). Per Susan's note, I'm attaching our PO template (EmberTech_PO_Template.pdf) and the vendor portal requirements. A few clarifications:

- Procurement preference is Net-45 but we can do Net-30 if Redwood prefers; please flag.
- We need the SOC2-supplement and the amendment redline to present to our security and legal teams by 4/18.
- Portal account: vendor@embertech-govsvc.com will be the service account we use for GovCloud onboarding. Please send the portal invite to that address and to me.

Timeline constraints: legal lock date is Apr 25 for any contract changes to hit the May 1 procurement cycle. If Redwood requires additional commercial review, let us know ASAP so we don't miss the run.

Thanks — attaching EmberTech_PO_Template.pdf

Hi Tom / Susan —

Attached are our initial redlines to the GovCloud addendum (Amendment-Redline-EMB.docx) and the proposed pricing / commit schedule for the GovCloud subset (Pricing-Commit-Schedule.xlsx). High-level notes:

- Commercial: GovCloud addendum carries a modest uplift to cover reserved capacity and cross-region replication; we proposed a 20% uplift on the subset capacity with an optional staged ramp to lower the effective uplift over 3 quarters.
- Payment terms: We can accept Net-45 for this deal; please confirm formally on the PO.
- Security: SOC2 supplement looks complete; Marissa will work on the portal invite and can share a pre-approved onboarding profile so the portal re-onboarding should be <5 business days once we have the service account.

Requested next steps for EmberTech:
- Confirm Net-45 on the submitted PO (Tom), include deal id EMB-4721 in the PO reference.
- Legal: confirm any redline comments by 4/18 so we can iterate and route for signature before Apr 25 lock date.
- Tom / Susan: once PO is uploaded to the portal, ping Marissa so she can finalize tenant mapping.

Attachments: Amendment-Redline-EMB.docx, Pricing-Commit-Schedule.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura Bennett

Thanks for the redlines and the pricing schedule. Confirming the following:

- EmberTech will issue PO_6789.pdf under Net-45 and will include EMB-4721 in the reference field. PO attached.

We'll aim to have the signed amendment and PO in the portal by end of day Apr 19. If Redwood can confirm the GovCloud capacity provisioning lead time (est. start of June), that will help schedule the migration kickoff.
